title: Establish provider-owned Codex observability bridge
scope: Add a local provider-owned launch contract that creates a Codex App Server thread, registers its stable identity with Temple, and only then begins generation.
Persist execution origin, provider, requested and effective model, reasoning effort, service tier, launch revision, current revision, and claim base as distinct bounded task metadata.
Validate with a fake App Server only; do not create a real Codex thread or turn, consume model Tokens, publish, push, deploy, or release.
acceptance_criteria: A fake App Server proves initialize, thread/start, canonical task registration, and turn/start occur in that order, and the thread is treated as live-attached without resume.
If canonical registration fails, turn/start is never sent and no raw instruction is retained in canonical state or telemetry.
A fake thread/tokenUsage/updated notification correlates to the exact Work Item, task, Position, launch revision, provider, model, and reasoning effort; unavailable fields remain unknown.
Existing Codex-host-owned task registration remains compatible and never claims provider ownership or fabricated Token observations.
Local focused tests, full npm run verify, Doctor, and fresh detached-worktree Independent QA pass before organizational closeout.
